desc: Search Colombian judicial cases by entity name. Optional filters narrow by entity type, court code, recent activity, and page.
Resolve a Colombian judicial case by radicado and return case metadata plus the first 40 actuaciones (actions) available.

Resolve up to 50 Colombian judicial cases by radicado in one request. Returns one result per radicado in input order, each with its own status, so a single bad radicado never fails the batch. Each item counts as one request against your quota.

Search the Rama Judicial's official email directory: the mailbox of every Colombian despacho judicial and administrative area, with its corporation, specialty, department, city and seccional. Filter by place, kind of office or specialty (case and accents ignored), or resolve a court directly from a case: the first 12 digits of any radicado are the `court_code` of the despacho that holds it, and a full radicado is accepted as-is. Free text reaches the office name, the address itself, and the office's classification and place. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Resolve the official mailbox of a Colombian court from its 12-digit court code (código de despacho), or directly from a full radicado: its first 12 digits identify the court where the case is filed, so a case number answers "whom do I email about this case" in one call. Returns every account the directory holds for that code, the despacho's own mailbox first, then its service and filing areas. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).
Check a Colombian cédula's vital status. Returns `found: false` if the cédula isn't in the registry; otherwise `status` is `ALIVE` or `DECEASED`.
Find a Colombian birth civil registry (office, serial, inscription date) by first surname, first name, sex and date of birth. Returns `found: false` when there is no match.
Look up a person's social-security affiliations in Colombia by document number. Requires the date the document was issued. `document_type` defaults to `CC`. (async: may answer 202 + status_url)
Search Colombian businesses in RUES by name, paginated, each result enriched with its full registry record.
Resolve a Colombian business by NIT and return its full RUES record: registry detail, financial statements, renewal history, related parties and registry notices.
Check a person's Colombian criminal record (antecedentes). `document_type` defaults to `CC`. (async: may answer 202 + status_url)

Live environmental conditions for the Aburrá Valley (Medellín metropolitan area) from SIATA: per-station weather (temperature, humidity, wind, pressure), rainfall (accumulated + intensity), and air quality (24h PM2.5 + ICA index). All inputs optional: an empty body returns every station; pass `latitude` + `longitude` (with optional `radius_km`, default 10) to get only nearby stations, nearest first with `distance_km` populated. Coverage is the Medellín metro area only.

Current weather at every SIATA station in the Aburrá Valley (Medellín metropolitan area): temperature, humidity, wind, pressure, an hourly 12-hour series per station, and the valley's UV index with today's hourly series. All inputs optional: an empty body returns every station; pass `latitude` + `longitude` (with optional `radius_km`, default 10) for nearby stations nearest first, or `municipality` / `station_code` to narrow. Coverage is the Medellín metro area only.

Minute-by-minute weather at one SIATA station in the Aburrá Valley (Medellín metropolitan area): temperature, humidity, wind speed and pressure over the last hour at one-minute resolution (`window: "1h"`, the default) or the last six hours at five-minute resolution (`window: "6h"`), with the source's means and temperature percentiles. `station_code` is required; codes come from the weather endpoint. Returns `found: false` for an unknown station.

Current river, stream and storm-sewer water levels for the Aburrá Valley (Medellín metropolitan area) from SIATA: per-station level in metres against the station's flood thresholds (with a derived status), the highest and mean level over the last three hours, the source's alert colour and level, six trailing windows, basin morphology and land cover. `include_series` adds a per-minute 3-hour series. All inputs optional: an empty body returns every station; pass `latitude` + `longitude` (with optional `radius_km`, default 10) for nearby stations nearest first, or `municipality` / `station_code` to narrow. Coverage is the Medellín metro area only.

Rain at every SIATA gauge in the Aburrá Valley (Medellín metropolitan area): whether it is raining now and the source's extreme-rain flag, rain accumulated over seven trailing windows (5 minutes to 30 days), and monthly totals for the current year with each month's data availability. All inputs optional: an empty body returns every gauge; pass `latitude` + `longitude` (with optional `radius_km`, default 10) for nearby gauges nearest first, or `municipality` / `station_code` to narrow. Coverage is the Medellín metro area only.

Current air quality at SIATA's reference stations in the Aburrá Valley (Medellín metropolitan area): 24-hour PM2.5 and PM10, 8-hour ozone and CO, 1-hour NO2 and SO2, each as a concentration with Colombia's numeric air-quality index (ICA) and its category, plus the pollutant driving each station's index. All inputs optional: an empty body returns every station; pass `latitude` + `longitude` (with optional `radius_km`, default 10) for nearby stations nearest first, or `municipality` / `station_code` to narrow. Coverage is the Medellín metro area only.

The citizen-science PM2.5 sensor network of the Aburrá Valley (Medellín metropolitan area), about 230 low-cost sensors: PM2.5 over the last hour, the daily air-quality index (ICA) with its category, whether each sensor is reporting, and its data recovery over 24 hours and 15 days. All inputs optional: an empty body returns every sensor; pass `latitude` + `longitude` (with optional `radius_km`, default 10) for nearby sensors nearest first, or `municipality` / `station_code` to narrow. Indicative data; use the air-quality endpoint for the reference network.

SIATA's two-day weather forecast for the Aburrá Valley (Medellín metropolitan area), per municipality and, for Medellín, per zone: daily maximum and minimum temperature and the likelihood of rain for each part of the day (early morning, morning, afternoon, night). Pass `municipality` to get one municipality; an empty body returns every zone. Issued once a day.

Official notices from SIATA, the early-warning system of the Aburrá Valley (Medellín metropolitan area): title, plain-text description, validity dates and audience. Returns the active notices; pass `include_past: true` for every notice on record, most recent first.

The last earthquakes recorded by SIATA's accelerograph and seismograph network in the Aburrá Valley (Medellín metropolitan area): per station, the most recent events with magnitude, epicentre, depth and what the station measured (peak ground acceleration and Mercalli intensity on accelerographs, peak ground velocity on seismographs). All inputs optional: an empty body returns every station; pass `latitude` + `longitude` (with optional `radius_km`, default 10) for nearby stations nearest first, or `municipality` / `station_code` to narrow.

SIATA's camera network in the Aburrá Valley (Medellín metropolitan area), about 90 cameras pointed at river gauges, the sky, underpasses and the boundary layer, each with the URL of its latest snapshot. All inputs optional: pass `latitude` + `longitude` (with optional `radius_km`, default 10) for nearby cameras nearest first, or `type` (`nivel`, `cielo`, `deprimido`, `capa_limite`) to keep one kind.

Search conceptos (public-procurement legal opinions) from the Relatoría de la ANCP-CCE (Colombia Compra Eficiente) by free text, tema (descriptor), and modification date. Paginated, newest-modified first. Drill into one with `ancp-cce-concepto` for the full text.
Retrieve one ANCP-CCE concepto by id or slug (e.g. `c-1094-de-2026`): full doctrinal text, dates, subjects and subtopics. `found: false` when nothing matches.

Search disciplinary rulings from the Relatoría de la Comisión Nacional de Disciplina Judicial (CNDJ) by free text or the advanced filters (reporting magistrate, topic, respondent, matter, subtopic, filing year). Returns the matching summaries with their `numero_unico` + `numero_ficha` key; read one in full with `cndj-ruling`.

Retrieve one CNDJ disciplinary ruling by its `registration_number` + `ficha_number` key: the editorial fields (titulación, descriptores, fuentes normativas, salvamentos) plus the ruling document and its extracted full text when it carries a text layer. `found: false` when no document is stored for that key.

Look up a Colombian criminal case by its 21-digit noticia criminal number, live from the Fiscalía General de la Nación (SPOA): status and closing reason, procedural stage, applicable law, date and place of the facts, the assigned prosecutor's office with its contact details, the offences with their grade, and the non-reserved actions, newest first. Returns `found: false` when the Fiscalía has no case with that number.

Search every notice the Agencia Nacional de Minería (Colombia) has published since May 2020 to notify decisions on mining titles and applications: estados, avisos, edictos and notices of general character. Filter by `title_number` (the placa, exact match), `office` (regional office), `type`, `year` and the publication date (`from_date`/`to_date`); free text matches the notice number and the full text. Each result lists every placa the notice covers and links to its document. Read one notice's full text with `anm_notice`. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Retrieve one notice of the Agencia Nacional de Minería (Colombia) by its `id` from a search result (e.g. `GGDN-2026-P-0378.pdf`) or its `document_url`: its full text, the notice number, kind, regional office, publication date, every placa it covers and the link to its document. The text comes back a character range at a time (`offset`, `limit`); follow `next_offset` until `has_more` is false. Find a `notice_id` with `anm_notices_search`.

Check whether a person is reported as a responsable fiscal in the Contraloría's SIBOR boletín (certificado de antecedentes de responsabilidad fiscal). `document_type` defaults to `CC`. Returns the verdict plus a verification code.

Full-text search over DIAN's published tax doctrine and related legal compilation: oficios, conceptos, decretos, resoluciones, leyes and high-court rulings. Each hit carries the `document_id` used by `dian-doctrina-document`, plus the title, issuing body, epigraph and a matching excerpt. Optional filters: `document_type` (e.g. `Oficios`, `Conceptos`) and `year`. Paginated with `page` and `per_page`; `capped: true` means the source returned more matches than are retrievable, so narrow the query.

Retrieve the text of one DIAN doctrine document by the `document_id` returned by `dian-doctrina-search`: the official title and the body of the oficio, concepto or norm. Compiled norms run to millions of characters, so the body is returned in character ranges: `content.total_length` is the full size, and when `content.has_more` is true request the next range with `offset: content.next_offset`. `found: false` when no document carries that id.

Validate a Colombian electronic document (factura electrónica, nota crédito/débito) by its CUFE/UUID and the emisor or receptor NIT. Returns the issuer, recipient, totals and taxes (whole pesos, as the registry publishes them), current legitimate holder, validations, and events, each with its `code` (030, 032, 033...), name, date and parties. Set `include_pdf: true` to also receive `pdf_url`, the URL of the official PDF representation. The issuer may protect that PDF with a password; when handing it over, tell the user which passwords to try, in this order: (1) the issuer's NIT without check digit (`issuer.nit`, e.g. 900108281), the most common; (2) the recipient's document number without check digit (`recipient.nit`); (3) the recipient's NIT with its check digit appended. If none works, point the user to DIAN's public catalog (https://catalogo-vpfe.dian.gov.co/User/SearchDocument), where pasting the CUFE downloads DIAN's own graphical representation. Do not try to open or extract a protected PDF with other tools; give the user the link and the password hints instead. A result is reused for 24 hours; pass `cache: false` to read the registry again, for instance after filing an event. `found: false` means the document is not registered under that CUFE, or the NIT matches neither the emisor nor the receptor. (async: may answer 202 + status_url)

Read the electronic invoices issued to the connected DIAN account holder in one tax year (2023 onward): issuer, dates, invoiced and net amounts, deductible amount, payment method, invoice number and CUFE, with totals. Persons only: runs as your organization's own DIAN connection signed in on its own behalf. (async: may answer 202 + status_url)

Read what third parties reported to DIAN about the connected account holder (the person, or the company the connection signs in for) in one tax year (información exógena, 2018 onward): the reporter, the concept and amount, and from 2023 the suggested use in the tax return, additional detail and the filing-threshold summary. Runs as your organization's own DIAN connection. (async: may answer 202 + status_url)

Search DIAN's directories of importers and exporters of goods, every year since 2017 and both directories at once: by company name (`query`), `flow` (`import` or `export`), `year`, and `tariff_code` (a 4-digit heading, 6-digit HS subheading or 10-digit subpartida among each company's five main ones). Each result is one company's row in one year's directory: NIT, name, rank, CIF (imports) or FOB (exports) value in US dollars, net weight, declarations or declaration items, and its main subpartidas arancelarias. Newest year first, then by value. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is), brought up to date weekly.

A Colombian company's foreign trade history by NIT, from DIAN's yearly directories of importers and exporters since 2017: its row in each year's importers directory (rank, CIF value in US dollars, net weight, declarations, main subpartidas arancelarias) and in each year's exporters directory (rank, FOB value, net weight, declaration items, main subpartidas), newest first. `found: false` when the NIT appears in no directory. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is), brought up to date weekly.

Colombia's labour-market series from DANE's household survey (GEIH): unemployment (TD), employment (TO), participation (TGP) and underemployment (TS) rates and the populations behind them, monthly for the nation (total and cabeceras) since 2001 and for the 13 main cities, as rolling quarters for 23 cities and metropolitan areas since 2007, and as rolling years for 32 cities since 2021. Filter by DIVIPOLA code, territory level, indicator, period type, domain and date range. Newest first. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Colombia's poverty and inequality from DANE: monetary and extreme poverty (incidence and people), Gini coefficient, income per capita and poverty lines for the nation, 23 departments and Bogotá since 2021; and multidimensional poverty (IPM) for the nation and its regions since 2010 and for all 33 departments since 2018, by total, cabeceras and rural. Filter by DIVIPOLA code, territory level, indicator, domain and years. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Multidimensional poverty (IPM) of each of Colombia's 1,122 municipalities from the 2018 census (DANE), by total, cabecera and rural, with the fifteen deprivations behind it (illiteracy, informal work, health insurance, water, overcrowding...). Filter by DIVIPOLA code (a municipality, or every municipality of a department) or by name. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

The 2018 national population and housing census (CNPV, DANE) for each of Colombia's 1,122 municipalities: people by sex and age, education, households, dwellings by type and occupancy, public services and internet, dwellings by estrato as billed for electricity, and land use. Filter by DIVIPOLA code (a municipality, or every municipality of a department) or by name. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Search the Gestor Normativo, the Colombian state's register of the norms that govern public administration: laws, decrees, conceptos, rulings, circulares and acuerdos from 1620 to today, across every kind and year at once. Free text matches the norm's citation, the register's own one-line description and the full text of the norm itself. Filter by `document_type`, `year`, exact `number` (with or without leading zeros), issuing `entity`, the `subject` the register files it under, and the date it was issued (`issued_from`/`issued_to`). Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Retrieve one norm of the Gestor Normativo by its `norm_id` from the search results: its consolidated text, the dates it was issued and entered into force, where it was officially published, the subjects the register files it under, and the later norms it records as having added to, modified or repealed it. The text comes back a character range at a time (`offset`, `limit`), because the longest norms run past a million characters; follow `next_offset` until `has_more` is false.

Search everything the Colombian Congress has published in the Gaceta del Congreso since 2000, document by document: proyectos de ley as filed, informes de ponencia, actas de comisión y plenaria, textos aprobados y definitivos, informes de conciliación, objeciones presidenciales and conceptos. Search the full text, or filter by `chamber`, `kind`, and by the bill a document is about (`bill_number`, `bill_year`) to follow one proyecto de ley through every stage of its passage. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Retrieve one document published in the Gaceta del Congreso by its `document_id` from the search results (e.g. `87176`), with its full text as the Gaceta published it, the issue it appeared in, and the proyecto de ley it belongs to.

Browse the issues of the Gaceta del Congreso themselves: every issue either chamber has published since 2000, by number, chamber and publication date. Use this to find an issue by its citation; use the Documents endpoint to search what is inside them.

Browse the Diario Oficial, the gazette where Colombian law takes effect: every issue the Imprenta Nacional lists, from number 23,962 of 2 January 1939 to this week's, by number, edition and publication date.

Search the properties (predios) of Colombia's national cadastre administered by IGAC, about 6.8 million in 831 municipalities: by `municipality_code` (DANE), `block_code` (the manzana or vereda, the first 17 digits of a cadastral number), words of the `address`, `economic_destination` (`A` housing, `C` commerce, `D` agricultural and others), `zone` (`urban`/`rural`) or `previous_cadastral_number`. At least a municipality, a block or a previous number is required. Each result carries the 30-digit cadastral number, address, destination, land and built areas, the land zones and every building unit with its use and score. Not for Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla or Antioquia, which keep their own cadastre. Read the appraisal of one with `igac_property`. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Retrieve one property of Colombia's national cadastre by its 30-digit número predial nacional, as IGAC's cadastre answers it today: the current avalúo catastral in pesos, address, land and built areas, economic destination, every building with its use, score and floors, and the parcel polygon. The first ask of a number reads IGAC; later asks within 30 days answer from Croma's stored answer (`served_from`), which is re-read regularly. Only for the 842 municipalities IGAC administers: a number from Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla or Antioquia returns `found: false`. Find numbers with `igac_properties_search` or a point with `igac_property_by_point`.

Find the property of Colombia's national cadastre at a point (`latitude`, `longitude`, WGS84) and answer as `igac_property` does: the parcel IGAC draws under the point, then its current avalúo catastral, address, areas, destination, buildings and polygon, served from Croma's stored answer when it holds a recent one. `found: false` when no IGAC parcel contains the point, which includes the cities that keep their own cadastre.

Retrieve the polygon of one parcel (terreno) of Colombia's national cadastre by its 30-digit cadastral number: the geometry as GeoJSON in WGS84, its centre, the block or vereda it sits in, the zone and the previous number. From IGAC's monthly publication, about 5.1 million parcels. Served by Croma.

List the parcels (terrenos) of Colombia's national cadastre in a municipality, optionally within one block or vereda (`block_code`) or one `zone`, each with its GeoJSON polygon in WGS84, centre and previous number. About 5.1 million parcels from IGAC's monthly publication. Served by Croma.

List the buildings (construcciones) IGAC's cadastre draws on one property, by its 30-digit cadastral number: each with its letter, type (`CONVENCIONAL` or `NO CONVENCIONAL`), ownership regime, floors, basements, mezzanines and footprint as GeoJSON in WGS84. About 3.8 million buildings. Served by Croma.
List the urban blocks (manzanas) of a municipality in Colombia's national cadastre, each with its 17-digit code, neighbourhood and GeoJSON polygon in WGS84. About 172,000 blocks. Served by Croma.

List the rural districts (veredas) of a municipality in Colombia's national cadastre, by name words when given, each with its 17-digit code, name, sector and GeoJSON polygon in WGS84. About 17,000 veredas. Served by Croma.

List the cadastral sectors of a municipality in Colombia's national cadastre, urban and rural, each with its polygon, and the municipality's urban perimeters (the line dividing urban from rural land) with the centre's name and appraisal regime. Served by Croma.

List the homogeneous geoeconomic zones (zonas homogéneas geoeconómicas) IGAC has adopted in a municipality, urban and rural, each with the land value per m² (urban, `value_per_m2`) or per hectare (rural, `value_per_hectare`) in pesos, the date the value is from, the physical zones it covers and its GeoJSON polygon. A property's `land_zones[].economic_zone_code` points at these; the land half of its appraisal is this value times the area. About 130,000 zones. Served by Croma.

List the homogeneous physical zones (zonas homogéneas físicas) IGAC has adopted in a municipality, urban and rural: topography, road influence, public services, land use and its norm and construction typology for urban zones; land class and water availability for rural ones; each with the date it is from and its GeoJSON polygon. About 190,000 zones. Served by Croma.

IGAC's cadastral statistics for one municipality of Colombia, whoever administers its cadastre, per zone and reporting year since 2017: the sum of every property's avalúo catastral (`appraisal_total`, pesos), the number of properties, built and land areas, the years of the last urban and rural updates and the cadastre's status. Optionally one `year` or one `zone`. Served by Croma.

Who administers each of Colombia's 1,122 municipal cadastres, as IGAC maps it: IGAC itself for 842, a departmental, metropolitan or municipal gestor catastral for the rest. Filter by `municipality_code` or by words of the manager's or municipality's name. `is_igac` says whether the municipality's properties are in this source. Served by Croma.

The address plates (nomenclatura domiciliaria) IGAC draws for one parcel of Colombia's national cadastre, by its 30-digit cadastral number: the text of each plate and where it sits, as GeoJSON in WGS84. About 3 million plates. Served by Croma.

The street names (nomenclatura vial) IGAC draws on the cadastral map of a municipality in Colombia, by words of the name when given, each with where it sits as GeoJSON in WGS84. About 150,000 names. Served by Croma.

Search the catalog of statistical series the Banco de la República, Colombia's central bank, publishes: about 850 series covering the TRM exchange rate, the monetary policy rate, IBR, DTF and deposit rates, lending rates by credit type, credit and monetary aggregates, consumer prices, unemployment, GDP, the balance of payments, remittances and regional activity. Free text matches the name, description, keywords and categories; filter by `frequency`. Each result carries the series code, unit, producer, first and latest observation, and the last and next update dates. Read a series' observations with `banrep_series`. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Read the observations of one statistical series of the Banco de la República (Colombia) by its code, the `id` of a search result, e.g. `1` (TRM), `59` (monetary policy rate), `15126` (consumer lending rate) or `15000` (consumer price index), optionally over a date range (`from_date`, `to_date`). Returns the series' metadata (name, unit, frequency, producer, last and next update) and every observation in the range as `date` and `value`, oldest first. Find a code with `banrep_series_search`. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Search every publication of the Banco de la República, Colombia's central bank: the Borradores de Economía working papers, the regional and urban economics working papers, Ensayos sobre Política Económica, the monetary policy and financial stability reports, the board's reports to Congress, the regional economic bulletins and ICER reports, the labour market, credit and financial markets reports, and books, about 5,700 in all. Free text matches the title, abstracts, keywords, subjects, authors and the full text; filter by `series`, `author` surname, `jel_code` (or its prefix, e.g. `E5`), `region` (a Colombian department) and date. Each result carries the authors, date, series, abstracts, JEL codes, departments covered, DOI and links to a copy of every file. Read one publication's text with `banrep_research_publication`. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Retrieve one publication of the Banco de la República (Colombia) by its handle, the `id` of a search result (e.g. `11430`), or its handle link: everything the search returns plus the text of its main document, a character range at a time (`offset`, `limit`; follow `next_offset` until `has_more` is false), and links to a copy of every file published with it. Find a handle with `banrep_research_publications_search`. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Saber 11 results of every Colombian school per exam period, 2010 to 2022 (Colombia's end-of-secondary exam, run by ICFES): students who sat it (each counted once) and their mean global score (0 to 500) and mean score in mathematics, critical reading, natural sciences, social studies and English, with the school's DANE code, name, sector, calendar, area and municipality. Free text matches the school and municipality names. Filter by `school_code` (12-digit DANE), `territory_code` (5-digit DIVIPOLA municipality or 2-digit department), `year`, `period` (`yyyy-1` or `yyyy-2`) and `school_sector` (`oficial`, `no_oficial`). Newest period first, highest mean global score first within it. 2018-2 and 2021-2 are not published. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Saber 11 results of every Colombian municipality by the socioeconomic stratum of the students' homes, per exam period, 2010 to 2022 (Colombia's end-of-secondary exam, run by ICFES): students who sat it (each counted once) and their mean global and per-area scores. Stratum is `1` to `6`, `sin_estrato` or `no_reportado`, as each student reported it. Filter by `territory_code` (5-digit DIVIPOLA municipality of the school or 2-digit department), `year`, `period` (`yyyy-1` or `yyyy-2`) and `stratum`. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Search every sanitary registration (registro sanitario) and mandatory notification (NSO) INVIMA, Colombia's food and drug authority, has issued or let expire: about 385,000 across medicines, food and drinks, cosmetics, medical devices, diagnostic reagents, supplements, biologicals and more. Free text matches the product names, the holder and the companies and people in every role. Filter by `registration_number` (any spelling), `holder` (matched from the start), `product_group` (e.g. `MEDICAMENTOS`, `COSMETICOS`), `status` (`vigente` or `vencido`) and the expiry date (`expires_from`/`expires_to`). Each result carries the number, dates, holder, every product name and every party. Read one registration with `invima_registration`. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Retrieve one sanitary registration of INVIMA (Colombia) by its file number (expediente), the `id` of a search result, e.g. `20190868`: the registration number, status, issue and expiry dates, holder, product group, modality, every product name it covers and every company or person in a role on it (manufacturer, importer, packager, attorney, legal representative, pharmacist). Find a file number with `invima_registrations_search`.

Search every commercial presentation of every medicine registered with INVIMA (Colombia), about 163,000 with their CUM code (Código Único de Medicamento): the registration and its status, holder, ATC code, pharmaceutical form, active ingredients with concentration, routes, pack, whether the presentation is active, and the manufacturers and importers. Free text matches the name, the active ingredients, the holder and the ATC description. Filter by `active_ingredient` (exact, e.g. `ACETAMINOFEN`), `atc_code` (a code or a prefix such as `N02`), `registration_number`, `file_number`, `holder`, `status` (`vigente`, `vencido` and others), `cum_status` (`activo`/`inactivo`) and the expiry date. Read one presentation with `invima_medicine`. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Retrieve one presentation of a medicine registered with INVIMA (Colombia) by its CUM code (Código Único de Medicamento), the `id` of a search result, e.g. `20042480-41`: the registration and its status, holder, ATC code, pharmaceutical form, every active ingredient with its concentration, routes of administration, pack, whether the presentation is active and since when, and the manufacturers and importers. Find a CUM with `invima_medicines_search`.

Education indicators of Colombia's Ministry of Education for every municipality and school year since 2011 (about 15,700 municipality-years): population aged 5 to 16, enrollment rate, net and gross coverage, dropout, approval, failure and repetition, overall and by level (transición, primaria, secundaria, media), in percent. Filter by `territory_code` (5-digit DIVIPOLA municipality or 2-digit department), `year`, or match municipality and department names with `query`. Newest year first. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Issue Brazil's labour-debt certificate (Certidão Negativa de Débitos Trabalhistas) for a company by CNPJ, live from the Tribunal Superior do Trabalho: `clear`, `debts`, or `debts_secured` (every debt secured or suspended, with the legal effect of a clearance), the certificate number, issue time and validity, and each labour case with its court and whether the debt is secured. Optionally the official PDF. Async job; most calls finish inline. (async: may answer 202 + status_url)

Check whether a Brazilian employer is up to date with the FGTS, by CNPJ, from Caixa Econômica Federal: `regular` with the current Certificado de Regularidade do FGTS (number, validity, establishment address), or `irregular` with which body reports the impediment (PGFN or Caixa). Optionally the certificates issued in the last 24 months. `found: false` when the CNPJ is not registered as an employer.

Search Brazil's register of employers caught keeping workers in conditions analogous to slavery (Cadastro de Empregadores, the "Lista Suja"), and the register of employers under a conduct-adjustment agreement, by CNPJ (or its 8-character root), CPF, name, state or inspection year. Each listing carries the establishment, workers found, activity, the final decision date and every period on the register. CPFs are matched exactly and returned masked. Updated daily.
One listing from Brazil's slave labour employer registers, by the `id` the search returns. `found: false` once the employer has left the register.

Search every environmental embargo Brazil's federal environmental agency (IBAMA) has imposed since 1987, by CPF or CNPJ (or its 8-character root), name or property, state, municipality, term number or date. Each embargo carries its status (`active`, `lifted`, `cancelled`), the area in hectares, the place, the infraction and the process; the response counts how many matches are active. CPFs are matched exactly and returned masked. Updated daily.
One environmental embargo from IBAMA by the `id` the search returns: the party, the place and area, the infraction and whether it is active, lifted or cancelled.

Search the catalog of Brazil's official statistics from IBGE: 9,000+ aggregate tables from PNAD Contínua, IPCA, PIB dos Municípios, Censo Demográfico and some 70 other surveys. Filter by words in the title, survey or variables, subject, periodicity or territorial level. Each table returns its periodicity, the periods it covers, the levels it has data for (country, region, state, municipality...), its variables with units and its classifications with their categories: everything `ibge-table-values` needs. Refreshed weekly.

Read the values of one of IBGE's statistical tables for Brazil: unemployment (table 4099), IPCA inflation (7060), municipal GDP (5938), Censo 2022 population (4709) and 9,000+ more. Choose the variables, the period (`latest`, one period or a range), the territorial level (country, region, state, municipality) with optional IBGE territory codes, and classification categories. Each value comes with its territory, period, unit and categories. Up to 15,000 values per call.

Search Brazil's federal legislation as the Presidência da República publishes it: the Constitution of 1988 and its amendments, and every lei complementar, lei ordinária, lei delegada, decreto-lei, decreto and medida provisória. Filter by `type`, a medida provisória's `measure_status`, exact `number` (with or without the thousands dot), signature `year` or a signature date range (`from_date`, `to_date`), and match free text against the act's name, its ementa and its full text. Results come most recently signed first, without the text; read one act with the Planalto Law endpoint. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Retrieve one Brazilian federal act by the `law_id` the search returns (`lei-13105-2015`, `cf-1988`): its current consolidated text, whole or one `article`, its ementa, signature and publication dates, whether it was revoked and by what, a medida provisória's standing and the law it became, the later acts that amended it article by article, and the earlier acts it amended in turn. The text comes back a character range at a time (`offset`, `limit`); follow `next_offset` until `has_more` is false.

Search the jurisprudencia the Corte Suprema de Justicia de El Salvador publishes: every resolution since 1951 from the Corte Plena and its Salas to the Cámaras, Tribunales de Sentencia and Juzgados. Free text matches the reference number, the court, the decision, the facts, the headnotes and the full text. Filter by `court_type`, `court`, `subject` (the area of law), `proceeding_type`, `type` (the kind of resolution), `crime`, `registration_number` (the reference number), `year` and the ruling date (`from_date`/`to_date`). Each result carries the original document, kept by Croma, and links to the record and the document on the court's own site. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Retrieve one resolution from the jurisprudencia of El Salvador's Corte Suprema de Justicia by its `id` from a search result (e.g. `1138697`) or its `official_url`: its full text, the reference number, the court, the area of law, the kind of proceeding and of resolution, the decision, the headnotes, the original document as the court published it, and the links to the record and the document on the court's own site. The text comes back a character range at a time (`offset`, `limit`); follow `next_offset` until `has_more` is false.

Search El Salvador's legislation as the Corte Suprema de Justicia's documentation center keeps it: more than 10,000 legal texts published in the Diario Oficial since 1821, from the codes and laws to executive decrees, regulations, agreements and municipal ordinances. Free text matches the name, the documentation center's summary and the consolidated text. Filter by `type`, `status` (`vigente`, `caducada`, `derogada`), `subject`, `number`, `municipality`, `department`, `year` and the publication date (`from_date`/`to_date`). Each result carries Croma's copy of the original document and links to the record and the document on the court's own site. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Retrieve one legal text of El Salvador by its `id` from a search result (e.g. `558819`, the Código Penal) or its `official_url`: its consolidated text, status, every amendment with its act and Croma's copy of its own text, the rulings related to it, and every version of its document Croma has kept. The text comes back a character range at a time (`offset`, `limit`); follow `next_offset` until `has_more` is false.

Search every decree of El Salvador's Asamblea Legislativa. Its register holds the laws, codes and regulations and every other legislative decree, from loan authorizations and tax exemptions to elections of officials and honorary distinctions. Free text matches the title, the Asamblea's summary and the full text. Filter by `type` (`Decreto`, `Ley`, `Código`, `Reglamento`), `subject`, `subtopic`, `area_of_law`, `number`, `year` and the date the decree was issued (`from_date`/`to_date`). Each result carries Croma's copy of the decree's document and links to the record and the document on the Asamblea's own site. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Retrieve one decree from the register of El Salvador's Asamblea Legislativa by its `id` from a search result (e.g. `7000`) or its `official_url`: its full text, number, kind, dates of issue and publication, Diario Oficial issue, subject, subtopic, area of law, the Asamblea's summary, Croma's copy of its document and the links to the record and the document on the Asamblea's own site. The text comes back a character range at a time (`offset`, `limit`); follow `next_offset` until `has_more` is false.

Search the jurisprudencia of Bolivia's Tribunal Constitucional Plurinacional and its predecessor: every sentencia, auto, declaración and vote since 1999. Filter by `type`, `chamber`, `proceeding_type` (the constitutional action), `reporting_judge`, `department`, `registration_number` (the resolution number), `case_number`, `year` and the ruling date (`from_date`/`to_date`). Each result carries the original document, kept by Croma, and a link to the resolution's page at the court. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Retrieve one resolution of Bolivia's Tribunal Constitucional Plurinacional by its `id` from a search result (e.g. `202697`) or its `official_url`: its full text, the resolution number, the chamber, the reporting justice, the constitutional action, the department, the case files, the original document as the court published it, and the link to its page at the court. The text comes back a character range at a time (`offset`, `limit`); follow `next_offset` until `has_more` is false.

Search the jurisprudencia of Bolivia's Tribunal Supremo de Justicia: every auto supremo, sentencia and resolución its chambers have published since 2001. Each result carries the document, kept by Croma, and a link to the resolution on the court's own site. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Retrieve one resolution of Bolivia's Tribunal Supremo de Justicia by its `id` from a search result (e.g. `11378`) or its `official_url`: its full text, the resolution and case numbers, the chamber, the kind of resolution and how it was resolved, the area of law, the reporting justice, the court's jurisprudence notes, the document as the court published it, and a link to the resolution on the court's own site. Search Japan's corporate number register (法人番号), about six million companies and other legal entities, by any part of the name in kanji, kana or English, narrowed by `prefecture` (name or JIS code), `city`, `entity_type` (the legal form), `status` (`active` or `closed`), `change_type` (the last change the register recorded) and the date of that change (`from_date`/`to_date`). Each result carries the corporate number, the names, the legal form, the head office, the registration status with any closure, and the last change. Served by Croma from its copy of the register (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Retrieve one Japanese company or other legal entity by its 13-digit corporate number (法人番号), e.g. `1180301018771`: the registered name with its reading and English form, the legal form, the head office, the registration status with any closure and successor, and the last change the register recorded. Served by Croma from its copy of the register (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Search the case law the courts of Japan publish: about 68,000 rulings of the Supreme Court, the high courts and the lower courts since 1947, across the administrative, labour and intellectual property collections too. Free text in Japanese matches the case name, the court's summary, the statutes cited and the full text. Filter by `collection`, `court` (matched from the start of its name), `case_number`, `year` and the ruling date (`from_date`/`to_date`). Each result carries the court's document, kept by Croma, and a link to the ruling's page at the courts. Served by Croma (`as_of` says how current the data is).

Retrieve one ruling of the courts of Japan by its `id` from a search result (e.g. `93117`) or its `official_url`: its full text, the case number and name, the court, the date, the outcome, the court's summary and the statutes cited, the court's document as published, and the link to its page at the courts. The text comes back a character range at a time (`offset`, `limit`); follow `next_offset` until `has_more` is false.
